notes: Student: Photo Search replaces Class Schedule and Grade Tracker. Bring-your-own Pixabay API key (free, 30-second signup, 5000 requests/hour rate limit). Search bar + image grid, click to open full size, right-click to copy URL. Setup screen walks the user through grabbing a key on first launch. Slot 7 now uses Quote of the Day (added to Student pool).
